Q1.baseline: walkable centerline/path graph + fixed-distance sampling + simple ray/sector visibility + Shannon richness/Jaccard scene change + k-shortest/beam/greedy route candidates with explicit length/repetition constraints and transparent ranking
Q1.author_route: Minkowski obstacle expansion + centerline graph + 50m/180° visibility + Shannon/Jaccard interest + weighted-sum improved GA
alternatives: epsilon-constraint/Pareto label-setting if graph size permits
orienteering/MILP or CP-SAT on a reduced candidate graph for bounded/exact comparison
NSGA-II only when genuine Pareto tradeoffs need preservation
visitor pairwise-preference/ranking model if independent perceptual labels exist
not_recommended: calling a weighted-sum GA a certified global multiobjective optimum
assuming OX automatically preserves path-edge feasibility
population-dependent min/max normalization when cross-generation objective comparability matters
Q1.why_select: the reusable value is the interpretable path/visibility/change representation; the optimizer should be selected by graph size, exactness budget and whether a true Pareto set is needed
Q1.switch_condition: promote exact/epsilon methods on reduced graphs; promote learned perceptual utility only with independent visitor/expert labels and garden-level holdout

Q2.baseline: small nonredundant grid/visibility/open-close indicators on a common dimensionless scale + explicit benefit directions + transparent weighted score + weight/threshold sensitivity + independent perceptual/expert validation
Q2.author_route: theme entropy/harmony/complexity + openness/rhythm/contrast -> 55/45 fusion -> force Jichang reference to 100 -> similarity/scale/culture/environment multipliers
alternatives: AHP/CRITIC/entropy weighting with auditable provenance and sensitivity
ordinal/ranking model if independent human illusion-quality labels exist
not_recommended: mixing incompatible component scales while declaring a fixed score range
using the anchor garden both to construct and validate the score
calling a monotone area bonus an “optimal moderate scale” effect
calling unbounded autocovariance scaling a normalized rhythm index
Q2.why_select: interpretable descriptors suit n=10, but every score component needs a closed scale and calibration/validation separation
Q2.switch_condition: use supervised ranking only after independent labels exist; use latent factors when redundancy/sensitivity shows hand-weighting instability

Q3.baseline: compact path/scenic/spatial descriptor + train/reference-cohort standardization + Gower or Euclidean/cosine distance chosen by data type + hierarchical clustering with bootstrap stability + predeclared external validation target
Q3.author_route: 20D descriptor + cosine/Jaccard/weighted-Euclidean fusion + Ward clustering + CV threshold/Kruskal-Wallis + eight expanded aesthetics/fuzzy scoring + three validation gardens
alternatives: Gower distance for mixed continuous/set/categorical features
PCA/factor analysis before Euclidean Ward if dimensions are correlated
metric learning only with external pairwise similarity labels
spectral/average-linkage clustering if using a non-Euclidean similarity matrix
not_recommended: Ward directly on an arbitrary fused non-Euclidean similarity without embedding proof
reporting 2/3 accuracy without predeclared truth labels
Q3.why_select: compact 20D is preferable to d>>n representations, but validation targets and metric geometry must be explicit
Q3.switch_condition: use learned metric/representation only when independent garden count and external labels are sufficient; otherwise keep compact interpretable distances with resampling
